movements.notes: half-marathon distance; this event scores the 2,000 m checkpoint split

origin.summary: An event from the 2013 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A half-marathon row, scored at the 2,000m checkpoint split.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2013/6 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; time cap 2 hours (men) / 2 hours 10 minutes (women); scored at the 2,000 m mark of a continuous half-marathon row
